exercises.name: Barbell Back Squat
exercises.description: Stand with the barbell across your upper back, feet shoulder-width apart. Squat down by bending your knees and hips, keeping your chest up, then drive through your heels to stand.

exercises.name: Deadlift
exercises.description: Stand with feet hip-width apart, barbell over mid-foot. Hinge at the hips, grip the bar, and lift by extending hips and knees while keeping your back flat.

exercises.name: Bench Press
exercises.description: Lie on a flat bench, grip the bar slightly wider than shoulder-width. Lower the bar to your chest, then press it back up until your arms are fully extended.

exercises.name: Overhead Press
exercises.description: Stand with the barbell at shoulder height. Press the bar overhead until your arms are locked out, then lower it back to the starting position.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.description: Hang from a bar with palms facing away. Pull yourself up until your chin clears the bar, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.description: Start in a plank with hands under your shoulders. Lower your chest to the floor, keeping your body straight, then push back up.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Bicep Curl
exercises.description: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand, arms at your sides. Curl the weights up toward your shoulders, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Tricep Dip
exercises.description: Place hands on parallel bars or a bench, support your weight. Lower your body by bending your elbows, then press back up.

exercises.name: Romanian Deadlift
exercises.description: Hold a barbell at hip height. Hinge at the hips, lowering the bar along your legs until you feel a stretch in your hamstrings, then return to standing.

exercises.name: Lunges
exercises.description: Step forward with one leg and lower your hips until both knees are bent at 90 degrees. Push back to the starting position and repeat with the other leg.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.description: Sit at a lat pulldown machine, grip the bar wider than shoulder-width. Pull the bar to your upper chest, then return under control.

exercises.name: Seated Cable Row
exercises.description: Sit at a cable row machine with feet on the platform. Pull the handle to your torso while keeping your back straight, then return slowly.

exercises.name: Dumbbell Shoulder Press
exercises.description: Sit or stand holding dumbbells at shoulder height. Press the weights overhead until your arms are extended, then lower back down.

exercises.name: Lateral Raise
exercises.description: Stand with a dumbbell in each hand at your sides. Raise your arms out to the sides until parallel with the floor, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Plank
exercises.description: Hold a forearm plank position with your body in a straight line from head to heels. Engage your core and hold for time.

exercises.name: Russian Twist
exercises.description: Sit on the floor with knees bent and feet lifted. Lean back slightly and rotate your torso side to side, optionally holding a weight.

exercises.name: Hanging Leg Raise
exercises.description: Hang from a pull-up bar. Raise your legs until they are parallel to the floor or higher, then lower under control.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.description: Hold a dumbbell vertically at your chest. Squat down keeping your chest up and elbows inside your knees, then stand back up.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.description: Place one foot behind you on a bench. Lower into a lunge on the front leg until your back knee nearly touches the floor, then drive back up.

exercises.name: Incline Dumbbell Press
exercises.description: Lie on an incline bench with a dumbbell in each hand at shoulder level. Press the weights up until your arms are extended, then lower.

exercises.name: Cable Tricep Pushdown
exercises.description: Stand at a cable machine with a rope or bar attachment at chest height. Push the attachment down until your arms are fully extended, then return.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.description: Stand with dumbbells at your sides, palms facing your body. Curl the weights up while keeping your palms facing inward, then lower.

exercises.name: Calf Raise
exercises.description: Stand on the edge of a step with your heels hanging off. Rise up onto your toes, then lower your heels below the step level.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.description: Set a cable to face height with a rope attachment. Pull the rope toward your face, separating the ends as you pull, then return.

exercises.name: Mountain Climber
exercises.description: Start in a high plank. Drive one knee toward your chest, then quickly switch legs, alternating in a running motion.
